name: Rare Threats in Your Environment

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/GuardDuty*
| json field=_raw "id", "type","severity" ,"title","description", "region"
| json field=_raw "service.action.networkConnectionAction.remoteIpDetails.country.countryName" as countryName
| toint(severity) as severity
| parse field=type "*:*/*" as threatpurpose, resource, threatname
| count by threatpurpose, threatname, resource, severity
| benchmark percentage as global_percent from guardduty on threatpurpose=threatpurpose, threatname=threatname, severity=severity, resource=resource
// A rare event is defined as something where the global percentage is less than 0.002
| where global_percent<.002
| count

description: Rare threats accounts for less than 0.2% of findings in the Sumo Logic customer population and should receive immediate attention.
